title: Conformational Locking through Intramolecular F···H Interactions in Dimerized M-Series Acceptors Boosts Efficiency and Stability of Organic Solar Cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06043E, Paper
Li Liu, Hongju Zhu, Jin-Yun Wang, Di Wang, Dongdong Cai, Jianbin Wang, Qisheng Tu, Yunlong Ma, Qingdong Zheng
Dimerized M-series small-molecule acceptors feature highly planar conjugated backbones, enabling ordered stacking and enhanced morphological stability. However, rotatable bonds introduced during dimerization often induce conformational disorder, undermining efficient charge generation...
